summary: isolation-vm and mail-redelivery-canaries run once a day only (daily-long.yml), no longer per pull request or in the merge queue: their jobs, evidence gates, linux-gate membership, required-check entries, skip-policy entries, lanes and local commands are removed, and the canary tests join the daily-only test group. scripts/st-test with no flags runs and signs the whole per-PR suite (typescript-client, genie-freshness, linux-gate's tests, clippy and fleet-compat); --all is an accepted alias.

replay.detail: No record or signature format changes.

schema.detail: No stored or wire format changes.

rules.detail: The skip policy drops the isolation-vm and mail-redelivery-canaries entries; linux-gate's aggregate command no longer lists them, and its host and agent command no longer runs the canaries stage. A linux-gate note signed before this change carries the old command and no longer matches.

compatibility.detail: The two checks must leave the main ruleset's required status checks before this merges, or no pull request can pass (the jobs no longer report). The pre-push hook and st-test ask for and run the whole suite with `scripts/st-test --push origin`.

manual.detail: An administrator removes isolation-vm and mail-redelivery-canaries from the main ruleset's required status checks (ruleset main) before this pull request is queued; the generated .github/repo-settings.json is the target state.

recovery.detail: Revert the pull request and re-add the two required checks to the ruleset.
